goal: Phase F2 of docs/MASTERY_PLAN_2026-07-31.md: prove that a Blueprint authored purely from JSON reacts to gameplay in PIE
context: Branch bridge/native-consolidation-2026-07-31. Live editor UE427PuerTSMCP, pipe UE427PuerTSMCP_UE427PuerTSMCP_81d778e7_skyshader5, level /Temp/Untitled_1 (12 actors). Every call driven through the freshly built mcp-server/dist over stdio with MCP_UNREAL_PROJECT_ROOT / MCP_PUERTS_TOKEN_PATH / MCP_PUERTS_PIPE, because the session's own MCP server process predates puerts_blueprint_build. No C++ change was needed.
design_decisions: The overlapping body is a second JSON-authored Blueprint, not a physics_build actor. physics_build spawns AStaticMeshActor, whose constructor calls SetGenerateOverlapEvents(false) (StaticMeshActor.cpp:33), and UPrimitiveComponent::CanComponentsGenerateOverlap requires the flag on both sides. A generated Blueprint's StaticMeshComponent keeps the UPrimitiveComponent default of true, so BP_ProbeDropper carries BodyInstance.bSimulatePhysics and falls under its own gravity. This also keeps the whole demonstration inside one authoring tool.

The trigger volume is a BoxComponent because UShapeComponent's constructor already sets the OverlapAllDynamic profile, so the reliable path needed no collision configuration at all. The question the phase asked about StaticMeshComponent collision was then answered separately, by probe, rather than by making the deliverable depend on the answer.

Geometry was chosen so the body crosses the volume and leaves it: trigger actor at (700,0,20), pedestal mesh 300x300x100 at relative z 50, box extent 150 at relative z 400 (world 270..570), dropper released at z 1100. Predicted rest height 170; the physics_build control run measured 170.00003, which confirms the arithmetic.

Placement follows the AGENTS.md trigger rule: PlayerStart was read first at (0,0,112). The volume's full extent is 300, so the rule wants 450 uu of clearance; the volume centre sits 765 uu away and the pedestal 700 uu away. Nothing the player spawns inside.
Each template change was verified on a freshly spawned instance, never on one spawned earlier, because of the known instance-staleness limitation.

collision_property_probes.result: rejected: "Component 'TriggerMesh' property 'CollisionProfileName': StaticMeshComponent has no reflected property by that name." The name lives on FBodyInstance, not on the component.
rejected with the same message. Component properties are reflected properties; a UFUNCTION is not reachable.

applied. A freshly spawned instance read back collisionProfileName OverlapAllDynamic, collisionEnabled QueryOnly, objectType ECC_WorldDynamic, ECR_Overlap on all eight channels, having been BlockAllDynamic / QueryAndPhysics before. FCollisionResponse::ResponseToChannels is UPROPERTY(transient) so the JSON does not write it; the recompile round-trips the template through an archive and UPrimitiveComponent::Serialize calls FBodyInstance::FixupData -> LoadProfileData, which reads the responses out of the profile.
applied, and read back true. The property is private on UPrimitiveComponent with a Blueprint getter and setter; reflection by name reaches it either way.

notes: The most useful negative result is limitation 9. physics_build looks like the obvious mover for a trigger probe and cannot be one, and the reason is an engine constructor two levels down. It cost one PIE run to prove and would otherwise have looked like a broken overlap graph.
Every blueprint_build save still logs 'Unable to Check Out From Source Control' as an auto-dismissed modal; the save succeeds.

The trigger asset ends in the configuration run 4 proved: TriggerMesh BlockAllDynamic / QueryAndPhysics, TriggerVolume at RelativeLocation z 400. The run-3 probe values were reverted and the revert was verified by read-back on a fresh instance.
recommended_next_goal: Phase F3 needs state and motion. The cheapest next probe is whether a CallFunction node can drive a door: class Actor, function K2_SetActorLocation, self target, from ActorBeginOverlap. If that works, a trigger-and-door slice is reachable inside today's eight node types, and only sound and HUD stay blocked. Otherwise re-fronting UBlueprintMutatorLibrary for variables and Timeline is the real unlock (limitation 8).
